# Get URLS From Input

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves URLS from the input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getURLSFromInput(text: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getURLSFromInput(text: "My favorite site is https://blacklivesmatter.com")
~~~~
